domestic.debt_note: No newer verified T-bill/PIB auction data was found than the 2026-09-03 MTB round: 6M cutoff 11.90%, 12M cutoff 11.99%, with the long-end PIB reference still 10Y 12.30%. The curve therefore remains restrictive into the September 14 MPC rather than offering a rate-relief signal.
domestic.remittances: Latest verified external-account cushion remains strong: July 2026 workers' remittances were about $3.63bn; August 2026 remittance headlines were seen in search but not promoted without a stable primary/major-source verification in this run.
domestic.current_account: July 2026 current account deficit was $328mn, narrower than June's revised $814mn deficit and July 2025's $529mn deficit. The improvement came from stronger goods exports, but the external account is still exposed to oil-import pressure.
